title: drypetes littoralis
intro: Drypetes littoralis, commonly known as sea pandan, is a species of plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Drypetes littoralis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
